region: Zambia (Lusaka, 41 periurban health centers, pop. 2.1M of 14.2M nationally)
background_incidence: NA - only outbreak counts given (2040 cases/14.2M pop over Jan 2010-Sep 2012; up to 369 cases per health center)
outbreak_frequency: Concurrent large typhoid outbreaks in Zambia, Zimbabwe, and DRC from Nov 2010 (refs 7-10); outbreak persisted ~33 months with minimal intervention/control programs
endemicity: Endemic with superimposed massive outbreak; Discussion states epidemiological data indicate typhoid is endemic in Zambia, outbreak ongoing 'for several years' before response
seasonality: Monthly case peaks clustering Nov-Apr (rainy season), e.g. 190 and 246 cases in Jan/Feb 2012 vs troughs of 1-49 cases mid-year (Fig. 1)
notes: Zambia (Lusaka); H58 lineage, novel H58B var. clone with chromosomal MDR translocation rather than IncHI1 plasmid
